text:
June: Pushed the updated KPI deck and the new weekly dashboard widget pack. Noticed a 22% gap between GA4 last-click and our lead-router attribution for paid social. Link: https://redwood.app/dashboards/weekly-kpis :mag_right:
analytics-bot: Auto-report: weekly leads 1,982 (+4% WoW); paid social leads 428 (-2%); avg demo conversion 19.8%. See full CSV: https://redwood.app/exports/kpi-weekly.csv (automated)
Omar: 22% is sizable. Could be GA4 cross-domain issues or our router deduping. Any specific campaign ids?
June: Mostly campaign ids like rw_launch_march and rw_retarget_q1. GA4 last-click marks some as twitter while router shows organic for same leads.
Priya: Do we have server logs that show the incoming referrer/utm payload at the time of submission? If utm disappears before submission GA4 might still attribute by last non-direct.
Riley: I can run a 7-day sample join: clicks -> sessions -> form_submits. Quick SQL below, will paste results.
```
SELECT s.session_id, c.utm_source AS click_src, s.ga_source AS ga_src, f.submit_id
FROM events.clicks c
LEFT JOIN events.sessions s ON c.session_id = s.session_id
LEFT JOIN events.form_submits f ON f.session_id = s.session_id
WHERE c.ts BETWEEN '2026-03-08' AND '2026-03-14'
LIMIT 500;
```
June: Perfect. If ga_src != click_src for same session that's a red flag.
Omar: Also check our inbound-router rules for fallback to "(direct)" or "organic" when utm missing. Sometimes we map unknown utm to "organic" which skews router counts.
Priya: Small note: Landing page redirect we added for A/B testing strips query params on 307 redirects in some browsers — I flagged this earlier. Could explain lost utms.
June: That matches symptom. If redirects strip params GA4 might reconstruct using last non-direct while our router relies on submitted utm.
analytics-bot: Attribution report ready: server-side router attributed 349 paid-social leads; GA4 last-click attributed 431 paid-social leads. Discrepancy concentrated on /lp/quickstart.
Riley: Raw sample shows ~14% of form_submits for /lp/quickstart had empty utm_source despite click logs showing utm present. Looks like redirect window.
Omar: Action plan: 1) Priya to rollback redirect-to-testing for /lp/quickstart or change to preserve query string. 2) Riley to add a landing-page widget that shows percent of submissions with missing utm by LP. 3) June to update deck with dual attribution columns (router vs GA4) for the execs. 4) Omar to run a short reconciliation job to reassign leads where click log exists but utm missing.
Priya: I'll open the PR to append query params after the redirect and add a tiny localStorage persist as fallback. Targeting PR by EOD.
Riley: I'll publish the widget to the dashboard and add a daily alert if missing-utm > 5% for any LP.
June: Can we also run a backfill for the past 30 days where click_id exists? If we can join we might correct the CRM attribution without contacting all leads.
Omar: I'll coordinate with Ops on the backfill; low-risk, just update the campaign field where we have matching click fingerprints.
June: Let's sync tomorrow 10:00 PT for 20m to review reconciliation numbers. If we fix redirects today we should see drop in discrepancy by tomorrow.
Priya: PR opened: #4125. Added test plan + canary.
Riley: Widget added: https://redwood.app/dashboards/weekly-kpis#missing-utm. Initial alert threshold set.
analytics-bot: Reconciliation job queued (job id: job_20260315_01). Will post results when complete.
June: Great work team. This was messing with our paid-performance narrative for the board. Keep updates here; closing thread after sync tomorrow. :raised_hands:
